## Why

The HCSN gap-closure baseline (#5001, `44e539313e0c54badb4b9b687425dd87ecba6e67`) keeps the Agentd engineering registration under `cfg(test)`. It therefore cannot establish the proposed Linux `production_ml_dsa65_v2` composition, and its prior tiny cancellation workloads can finish before a cancellation reaches the worker.

## Changes

- Port the focused existing ML-DSA-65 FinalUse authority and external signed clock/frontier implementation, with pinned dependencies, regenerated Cargo/Bazel locks, and explicit source provenance.
- Add normal-build Linux Agentd schema-3 HCSN registration, a signed deployment contract and exact Python source inventory, protected descriptor reads, and deny-before-contact validation around durable claims and native process spawning.
- Reauthenticate the revocation feed and the complete external frontier; bind the consumed token after the durable await; preserve the original owner, receipt, replay, and historical-read semantics.
- Add real signed Start/Cancel and fresh-process cold recovery through the classical driver and the PQ Agentd host. Preserve actual process identity, exact receipts, rejection cases, terminal-output checks, and all backend outcomes.
- Add explicitly identified 8-bin CPU cancellation fixtures with admitted longer traces, while retaining the existing default 32-bin graph/checkpoint identity. The shared Python loader rejects source aliases and undeclared import paths.
- Extend the unchanged closed-caller checker manifest with six typed PQ boundaries and eleven exact source pins. No prior caller definition or caller set is widened.
- Qualify the same PR head in the dedicated HCSN workflow: strict 69-test Python suite, three original signed worker bridges and second training blocks, three classical cancellations, three PQ-host cancellations, contracts/automation/Agentd tests, and normal-build Agentd compilation.

## Review structure

The branch is split into focused review commits: native primitives and locks; focused authority port; authority regressions; native contact guard; source/config/deployment boundaries; Agentd integration; classical and PQ real-worker recovery fixtures; numerical workload compatibility; qualification; documentation/provenance; and typed-caller negative-proof closure. Imported implementations and generated lock files are explicitly recorded as mechanical larger changes.

## Validation observed before publication

- Contracts compile passed; local contracts tests: 192 passed and 5 Unix-socket tests failed with the sandbox's `EPERM`. Hosted CI must run the complete set.
- Automation: 120 passed, 2 ignored integration fixtures selected explicitly by qualification wrappers.
- Python: 64/64 passed before the five added spatial tests; four spatial checks passed in a separate run. Later five-test startup attempts were killed with exit 137 and do not count as passing.
- The earlier real classical cancellation attempt passed A, while both B cases truthfully failed the terminal/output checks due to short workloads. The new longer A/grid-B/age-B fixtures each passed one-step admission preflight; full cancellation and PQ-host acceptance remain pending hosted CI.
- Final caller audit: 51 boundaries, 25 protected files, 4,452 Rust files; checker self-test, 10 typed tests, and 14 undeclared-caller negative probes passed. All 11 source pins match; the checker code and all 45 baseline boundaries are unchanged.
- Real `just bazel-lock-update`, contracts scoped fix, final repository formatting, Python/YAML/TOML parse checks, and diff checks completed. No post-format local test result is claimed.

All prior failed attempts and partial evidence are retained. This draft's exact-head hosted results will determine acceptance.

## Explicit remaining boundaries

The fixture exercises the actual normal-build PQ host registration with local signed trust services. It does not boot the Agentd daemon, exercise AuthBus ingress (which remains classical Ed25519), establish independent production key custody, deploy a service, or prove worker optimizer entry before cancellation. No production deployment or adoption is performed.

The spatial/time discretization and detached initial state of the next serialized training block remain explicit numerical boundaries. BP remains the task-loss autograd gradient; NDU, credit receipts, eligibility, value scores, and local plasticity retain their own semantics.

The separate desktop CUDA campaign is untouched. Broader repository CI has known baseline failures and is not described as green.
